text:
deploy-bot: Started canary deploy v2025.3 -> eu-west-1 (canary-8921) at 11:00 UTC to 5% traffic.
alice_oncall: getting p95 spikes on /generate, dashboard shows error rate jump to 2.8% for that canary. paging.
incident-bot: @alice_oncall paged for high error rate (SEV2). incident channel created.
bob_sre: I see a surge in 500s from the serving runtime; autoscaling looks healthy but latency and errors spike under the new kernel path.
alice_oncall: auto-rollback attempted but status says partial rollback: some routes still pinned to canary-8921. need manual unwind.
bob_sre: on it. hypothesis: a routing pin for long-lived connections prevented drain. steps: 1) flip feature flag 2) drain canary 3) force-route fallback.
carol_product: impacted customers: ACME (acct-acme-prod) and two beta tenants saw 500s and timeouts between 11:02-11:08 UTC. potential user-facing failures for generation APIs.
bob_sre: Running flag toggle: ```curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"enable_new_runtime","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'```
support_team: please post a proactive note to ACME and open a ticket. include timeframe and mitigation in the message.
alice_oncall: toggled flag via console, response: {"flag":"enable_new_runtime","status":"disabled","by":"alice_oncall"}.
bob_sre: initiating drain: ```kubectl rollout pause deploy/serve-canary-8921; kubectl annotate svc/serve canary-drain=true``` - starting connection drain window 60s.
incident-bot: Manual rollback request logged by @bob_sre.
bob_sre: Route sweep shows two edge proxies still routing 1.2% to canary due to sticky sessions. forcing route override: ```edgectl route override --target default --exclude canary-8921 --force```
alice_oncall: override applied. metrics indicate traffic to canary node falling to 0.
bob_sre: smoke checks: ```curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health``` -> "200 0.098"; run a sample generate: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq '.text'``` -> returns OK.
carol_product: thanks — drafting customer-facing blurb: "We rolled back a canary of v2025.3 due to elevated error rates for a subset of tenants. Traffic has been restored to the previous runtime; we’re monitoring." will share with support_team for review.
support_team: message approved, sending to ACME and beta list now.
bob_sre: verifying logs for residual 5xx: sampling past 5m shows errors back to baseline <0.05%.
alice_oncall: reenabled normal routing, canary-8921 marked quarantined. leaving monitoring on for 30m. if error rate >0.5% reopen page.
incident-bot: Incident brief saved to incident tracker: ID INC-2025-0912. Owner: @alice_oncall.
carol_product: postmortem owner assigned to @bob_sre; initial blameless notes: regression in kernel-selection for small batch sizes.
alice_oncall: thanks all for quick coord. closing thread, will update when postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
